notes: BETA: brand multipliers now come from your Vendor Price List. Setup → Import Vendor Price List… reads column F of the first tab: brands with a single multiplier are loaded automatically (147 in the current list); brands with tiered/text pricing (e.g. Kohler '0.57 / 0.50', Newport Brass) are flagged so you're asked to pick the right multiplier when a quote uses them, with the vendor note shown. No more 0.4 default — the prompt starts blank. Also includes the PDF reader fix and Deluxe pricing from 1.049b.
